name: Full context

stages.ingestion: The whole history is kept as raw text.
stages.retrieval: None: the entire history is placed in the context window.
stages.answer: The LLM answers with the full transcript in context.

summary: Generic baseline, not a system: the whole conversation history is put in the model's context window with no memory mechanism.
notes: Generic baseline used across papers. Instances differ: Mem0 (2504.19413) passes ~26k tokens per LoCoMo conversation; A-Mem's and Mem0's 'LoCoMo' baseline (Maharana et al. 2024) is also recorded here with variant 'LoCoMo baseline' because A-Mem App. A.1 describes it as the complete preceding conversation in the prompt. Model and truncation differ by paper - see result notes.
